Cornucopians! We’re excited to share our latest initiative with ApeBond, offering our community a unique chance to acquire $COPI tokens at a discount. Monday, August 12, 2024 at 1:56 PM

@everyone

We are thrilled to introduce Eric Peterson!

We are excited to introduce Eric Peterson, one of the newest members of our advisory board. Eric brings a wealth of expertise in game mechanics and production, and we are thrilled to have him contribute to the future of our game development. We invite you to learn more about Eric and look forward to his appearance on Copi Cafe Episode #101 this week! 

Eric Peterson, co-founder of Star Citizen at Cloud Imperium Games, is a seasoned game developer with extensive experience in game design, project management, and leadership. He played a key role in the development of Star Citizen and its successful crowdfunding campaigns. Additionally, Eric has made significant contributions to high-profile projects at Origin Systems, and Digital Anvil, in games like Wing Commander, Starlancer, Conquest Frontier Wars, Descent, and many others.

“I have been making games for more than 40 years and have been involved in some amazing AAA projects. Web 3 has been in desperate need of quality game development and when I saw what Cornucopias was doing, I immediately recognized that AAA quality experience and attention to detail. I can’t wait to get my hands on Cornucopias it is exactly the kind of quality experience gamers want.”
